annotation.material_differences: None that plausibly change the criterion-level evidence; B and C preserve the same monitoring, trigger, escalation, and follow-through commitments as A.
annotation.equivalence_rationale: All three responses identify the needed execution information (milestones, parts ETA, workaround, schedule realism), recognize the trigger for action when the delay threatens completion or the schedule slips, and commit to escalating to the appropriate owner and verifying follow-through with the next shift and subsequent updates. B adds some detail about ownership and formal acceptance of the new timeline, but this does not materially change the evidence or operational commitments relative to A and C.
